title: Builder
summary: Assemble one object with many optional parts, and refuse a half-built object.

parts.rule: Use a builder when many optional fields must combine into one valid object, and block build until required parts exist.
parts.why: Telescoping constructors hide which combinations are legal. A builder can enforce completeness.
parts.example: SAMPLE: an HTTP request builder requires a method and URL before build(); optional headers may be absent, but build throws if URL is missing.
parts.use: Use for objects with several optional pieces and a clear validity rule.
parts.refuse: Refuse a builder for a type with two fields and no invariants. Refuse returning partially initialized instances.

body:
Rule. Use a builder when many optional fields must combine into one valid object, and block build until required parts exist.

Why it matters. Telescoping constructors hide which combinations are legal. A builder can enforce completeness.

SAMPLE example. SAMPLE: an HTTP request builder requires a method and URL before build(); optional headers may be absent, but build throws if URL is missing.

When to use. Use for objects with several optional pieces and a clear validity rule.

When to refuse. Refuse a builder for a type with two fields and no invariants. Refuse returning partially initialized instances.
